comments.author: MelvinBot
comments.text:
## Proposal

### What is the root cause of that problem?

This is expected behavior, not a bug. The QA steps are missing a precondition.

- **Payment details page:** The "Find an active user" search field only shows when the month has 12 or more active users (`CONST.STANDARD_LIST_ITEM_LIMIT`). See [PaymentActivityTable/index.tsx:68](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/a60491fded4b38f6c379d00f36b58f98ce79801c/src/components/Tables/PaymentActivityTable/index.tsx#L68). The tester's account likely has fewer than 12 active users, so the search field stays hidden.
- **Payment history page:** This page never had a search field. [\[CFI\] Payment history: Activity list with the active user count](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104325) only added search to the Payment details page.

Design confirmed the 12-user rule during review, in [this comment on the PR](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/104325#issuecomment-6263433314). The PR's QA step "Verify the search functionality works well" didn't mention that a month needs 12+ active users.

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?

No code change is needed under the current rule. To retest, QA should open a month with 12 or more active users. Then confirm that:

1. The search field appears.
2. Searching filters by name or email.
3. A search with no matches shows "No results found".

If design decides to always show the search field, as `shawnborton` mentioned tables usually do, remove the 12-user check at [PaymentActivityTable/index.tsx:68](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/a60491fded4b38f6c379d00f36b58f98ce79801c/src/components/Tables/PaymentActivityTable/index.tsx#L68). Then always pass `Table.FilterBar` when the month has active users, and update the hidden-search case in `tests/ui/PaymentDetailsPageTest.tsx`.

### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional)

Adding search to the Payment history list page. That page wasn't in scope for [\[$175\] \[CFI\]\[FE 5/7\] Payment history: Activity list with the active user count](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/101832), so it would need its own design decision.

<details>
<summary>Related issues</summary>

- [\[$175\] Active users count are different on payment history and payment details page](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/104962) was filed from the same QA run. It's a separate issue.

</details>
